title: Text-Driven Artistic Staging: Pose, Lighting, and Camera References from Paintings
abstract: arXiv:2608.28823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artists coordinate human pose, illumination, and camera placement to convey narrative and emotion, but existing generative methods typically model these elements independently. We introduce text-to-editable 3D staging, a task that jointly generates human poses, a dominant light, and a camera configuration from an affective description. We construct 11,911 text--staging pairs from 2,328 figurative paintings by reconstructing SMPL bodies, estimating low-frequency illumination, recovering camera parameters, and pairing each scene with ArtEmis descriptions. We train a flow-matching transformer that supports variable numbers of figures and produces multiple staging alternatives for each prompt. On held-out descriptions, the model achieves 32.2\% retrieval R@1, compared with 16.6\% for CLIP-based nearest-neighbor retrieval, while approximately preserving corpus-level diversity. translated_title: 文本驱动的艺术舞台调度：从绘画中获取姿态、光照与相机参考
translated_abstract: 艺术家通过协调人体姿态、光照和相机位置来传达叙事与情感，但现有的生成方法通常对这些元素进行独立建模。我们提出了“文本到可编辑3D舞台调度”这一新任务，即从情感描述中联合生成人体姿态、主光源和相机配置。我们从2,328幅具象绘画中构建了11,911对文本-舞台调度配对数据，具体做法包括重建SMPL人体模型、估计低频光照、恢复相机参数，并将每个场景与ArtEmis中的描述文本相配对。我们训练了一个流匹配Transformer模型，支持数量可变的人物，并能针对每个提示生成多个舞台调度方案。在保留测试集的描述上，该模型达到了32.2%的检索R@1，而基于CLIP的最近邻检索仅为16.6%，同时大致保持了语料库级别的多样性。这些结果证明了生成可编辑舞台调度方案的可行性。
tldr: 本文提出“文本到可编辑3D舞台调度”新任务，从2,328幅具象绘画中构建了11,911对数据集，并训练流匹配Transformer从情感描述中联合生成人体姿态、主光源和相机配置，检索准确率（32.2%）几乎达到CLIP基线（16.6%）的两倍。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the task of text-to-editable 3D staging, constructing 11,911 text-staging pairs from 2,328 figurative paintings and training a flow-matching transformer to jointly generate human poses, dominant lighting, and camera configurations from affective descriptions, achieving 32.2% retrieval R@1—nearly double the 16.6% of CLIP-based nearest-neighbor retrieval.
